prompt: A British city skyline at night seen from a hill of terraced houses: the tall tower cranes on every building site have pulled themselves out of their concrete bases and stand on their own, their jibs swinging, red lamps at the top, half-built towers cracking where they were attached; the streets below are rivers of headlights. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
